description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, serving as the entry point. It sets up a fragment-based UI, manages a log display toggle, and configures logging infrastructure within the app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity for the Android app, responsible for UI setup, fragment transactions, menu actions, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and sets up the default fragment if none exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resources.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu items dynamically based on runtime conditions, such as visibility and title.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, notably toggling the log display view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Configures the app's logging infrastructure, chaining together log nodes and setting up log view fragment.
